Docker daemon is not running on this host (docker info exit 1), so the Docker dependency-failure negative control from the WP-0A spec is NEEDS_HOST and is not encoded as a runnable control.
This packet verifies the frozen bootstrap path on this host; the clean-container claim is CI evidence, not local evidence.

Packet gates and controls run under the runner-admitted system python3 (scripts/governance/run_agent_work_packet.py:121-130 admits only bare python3/sys.executable, never .venv/bin/python), and tests/conftest.py references dharma_swarm modules, so gate execution assumes repo dependencies importable by system python3 — CI installs them; a clean host that only ran make bootstrap has them in .venv only.
